vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: hum
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is designed to interact with the hum.pub API for publishing and managing articles. It explicitly requires network access and the `HUM_API_KEY` environment variable, which are legitimate for its stated purpose. The `SKILL.md` provides clear, functional instructions for the AI agent on how to use the API, without any evidence of prompt injection attempts to subvert the agent's behavior or perform actions beyond the stated purpose. All described API calls target `https://hum.pub`, and there are no indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or persistence mechanisms within the provided files.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward hum.pub API integration. Before installing: (1) Verify the HUM_API_KEY you supply is an author API key intended for this use and not a wider-scoped secret (do not reuse high-privilege or unrelated keys). (2) Confirm the referenced homepage/repo (https://hum.pub and the GitHub link in SKILL.md) match the service you expect — registry metadata had a minor mismatch. (3) Remember the agent may call the API autonomously using your key; if you don’t want autonomous publishing, restrict invocation or disable the skill. (4) Monitor activity and be prepared to rotate the HUM_API_KEY if you see unexpected requests. If you need higher assurance, review network logs or test with a scoped/test account first.
